Date

Subject
Minecraft Education Esports pilot

Dear Vera,

I have been running coding and robotics activities at the school for several years. This term I am again scheduled to teach two Minecraft coding courses on Thursday afternoons.

I would like to propose a small Minecraft Education esports pilot. The concept would combine coding, collaborative problem solving and team-based challenges.

Proposed three-phase approach

  1. Develop the competition concept and learning objectives.
  2. Train one or more teams internally at the school.
  3. Only after an internal pilot, explore regional or international competition.

Initial assumptions

  • A concept workshop could take place on 12 September 2024.
  • Internal team training could start on 19 September 2024.
  • I estimate that around 20 students might be interested.
  • The pilot could potentially connect to cross-curricular objectives such as collaboration, citizenship or sustainability.

I have seen reports and examples suggesting that Minecraft Education can support STEM learning and social collaboration. I think this makes the format promising, but the concrete learning objectives for our pilot would still need to be agreed with the school.

If the proposal is of interest, I would be happy to develop it further with the school team.

Kind regards,
Chris Berger
